metadata.title: nab-Paclitaxel Weekly Monotherapy - 28 day
metadata.indication: Metastatic breast cancer after anthracycline failure or when anthracyclines are unsuitable; this weekly off-label schedule is intended for patients hypersensitive to or unable to receive standard paclitaxel formulation.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m² IV over 30 minutes on Days 1, 8 and 15 every 28 days; Day 22 is a treatment break. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
audited_eligibility: Metastatic breast cancer after anthracycline failure or when anthracyclines are unsuitable; this weekly off-label schedule is intended for patients hypersensitive to or unable to receive standard paclitaxel formulation.
No hypersensitivity to nab-paclitaxel, albumin or excipients
Off-label use: explain and document consent under local policy; hospital Drugs and Therapeutics Committee acknowledgement
Baseline grade ≥2 neuropathy and severe hepatic impairment are source exclusions
audit_limitations: Independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy review remains pending; source reconciliation is not clinical-use authorisation.
No fixed routine CT, tumour-marker or cardiac-monitoring interval is specified; use the individual treatment plan.
Dose history is required before a numeric reduction; existing reductions must not be re-escalated.
Table 2 count thresholds (ANC ≥1, platelets ≥75) conflict with subsequent-cycle recovery thresholds on page 4 (ANC >1.5, platelets >100); hold and clarify cycle/day and local interpretation.
Table 2 intermediate AND row does not explicitly cover mixed bands, and exact ANC 1 / platelets 75 overlap its full-dose row; no numeric clearance is inferred.
Page 1 severe hepatic exclusion conflicts with Table 3 moderate/severe approximately 80%; severe impairment remains excluded pending specialist clarification.
Page 1 grade ≥2 neuropathy exclusion conflicts with Table 4 recovery to grade ≤2; recovered grade 2 needs explicit review.

baseline: ECHO/MUGA where clinically indicated, including significant cardiac history or prior anthracyclines
ongoing: FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle
